acceptance.clocks: inPlay + stoppage = elapsed at fixed-tick precision
acceptance.mechanicalRegression: Both frozen native extreme retreats regain feasible passes and release before another 12m retreat. This is a scenario diagnostic, never a production restriction.
acceptance.physicalRegression: No possession from pursuit; finite real contacts and acceleration; touch/secure-control distinction; emergency substitutions stay legal.
acceptance.independence: Three newly materialised SS/SW/WW designs, zero simulated validation ticks before this freeze. No consumed PR182 input is used as new evidence.
acceptance.quality: Report territorial purpose, shot distance/angle/pressure/attributes/physical outcomes, censored attempts, contact/foul events and all five policies. No event quotas or policy promotion.
acceptance.readiness: Do not call summary calibration ready if circulation, goalkeeper/shooting behaviour or other serious realism limits remain. Full unchanged npm run verify must pass before merge readiness.

definitions: pr183Observation.ts and unchanged PR181/182 flow/role observers, identified by harnessHash. Paired design is the experimental unit; 15 matches are three designs, not 15 independent samples.
